questions.q_en: Which statement correctly describes Medicine safety?

Medicines should be stored out of reach of younger children
Combustion reactions are exothermic and release heat
Vaporized fuel, oxygen, carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide, water vapour and other volatile substances may be present
